# Ross Gibson

> Data and analytics in Chicago. Ten years across finance, data and analytics:
> nine at Kraft Heinz moving from financial analyst to senior data engineer,
> and now Data Program Manager for Finance Data and Analytics at Google.
> Side projects run to Ethereum infrastructure, ESP32 hardware, and WebGPU.

Personal site. Four pages, no blog, no tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rossgibson.dev/): a WebGPU scene, and nothing else. A field of
  cipher characters resolving into real code behind an RG monogram lit from its
  own contour.
- [Work](https://rossgibson.dev/work): employment history, most recent first.
- [Projects](https://rossgibson.dev/projects): side projects, with star counts
  read live from the GitHub API.
- [About](https://rossgibson.dev/about): biography, education, certifications,
  and the tools used day to day.

## Facts

- Name: Ross Gibson
- Location: Chicago, Illinois, United States
- Current role: Data Program Manager, Finance Data and Analytics, at Google
  (from September 2026)
- Previously: Kraft Heinz, 2016 to 2025, seven roles from Financial Analyst to
  Senior Data Engineer and Staff Technical Specialist
- Education: M.S. Data Science, DePaul University; B.B.A. Finance, University
  of Iowa
- Certifications: Generative AI Leader and Cloud Digital Leader, Google Cloud
- Works with: Python, SQL, dbt, Dagster, Snowflake, Azure, Google Cloud, AWS,
  FastAPI, Tableau, Power BI, Grafana
- After hours: Rust, C and ESP-IDF, TypeScript, WebGPU
- GitHub: https://github.com/gibz104
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rosskgibson

## Notable projects

- SpoolmanSync: automatic filament tracking for Bambu Lab and Creality printers
  through Home Assistant and Spoolman. TypeScript.
- reth-db-py: reads Reth's MDBX database from Python, skipping JSON-RPC. Rust.
- Sproutlink: soil sensors assembled by hand, C firmware, TypeScript web app.
- SafeGithubOTA: over-the-air ESP32 firmware updates from private GitHub
  releases, with working rollback. C++.
- Rethix: an Ethereum indexer running in-process as a Reth Execution Extension.
- Libertas Node: a self-hosted Ethereum node publishing its own dashboards and
  logs, contributing to ethPandaOps' Xatu dataset.
- Weiwizard: a chat wrapper answering from the Ethereum standards through
  retrieval-augmented generation.
